releases.displayName: Important update about Ova Magica's console release

items.text: Hello everyone,

As we count down the days until Ova Magica's console release, we have good and bad news. Originally, we had hoped to announce this alongside the console launch, but unfortunately it looks like timelines won't align to make it possible. To start with the good news, Ova Magica will be coming natively to Switch 2 - not just through backwards compatibility with Switch 1. We originally did not plan for this, given the game's development started much before Nintendo had officially announced the console. Supporting the new hardware required significant changes to our console codebase for native Switch 2 support.

As a result, we've needed a little more time to finish and polish the other console versions. While we are near the finish line, we want every console version to launch in the best possible state. and ensure stability across all of Ova Magica's announced console platforms.

We will now be planning a release date on 8th September 2026 for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation, and Xbox. All kickstarter requests will still be honored. Similarly, physical editions will still ship to all backers and also enter retail sale soon after launch, more news of which will be delivered soon. Thank you for your continued support.
Top Hat Studios & ClaudiaTheDev

releases.displayName: Important Update - Upcoming Major Announcement and More!

notes.title: Hello to our amazing Ova Magica community 💚

items.text: Over the past months, we’ve been working incredibly hard on Ova Magica and its full release.

A huge part of that effort has been localization — translating over 300,000 words into multiple languages (Simplified Chinese, German, French, Spanish, and Japanese) — which turned out to be far more time-intensive than we expected.
On top of that, we’ve also been preparing for a console release. It’s been a big journey for our small team!
First of all: thank you 🙏

Your patience, support, and understanding truly mean the world to us. As a very small team working on a big game without the resources of a large studio, things sometimes take a bit longer — and we’re incredibly grateful that you’ve stuck with us along the way.

notes.title: With this small update, we have 2 important things to share!

items.text: 1) Upcoming Announcement 📢
You can expect a MAJOR public announcement at the very end of May 🎉
We can’t share all the details just yet — but we promise it’ll be worth the wait!
2) Price Adjustment 💰
Starting April 24th, the price of Ova Magica will increase to:
$29.99 / €29.99 (and equivalent in other currencies).
This reflects the final game price, so it will not increase again.

notes.title: We also want to give a small 1.0 Beta recap

items.text: The 1.0 Beta is now complete, and the full release of Ova Magica will bring a wide range of improvements, quality-of-life updates, and brand-new content.
The balancing and QoL improvements were especially praised by Beta players, and many of these changes stem directly from player feedback and reviews.
Here is a super rough overview of just some of the most anticipated changes for 1.0 to make the game feel and play better:
✨ Quality of Life Improvements + Balancing
No more fainting at midnight
Longer days
Reworked energy system (less punishing, more fun)
Rebalanced economy (shops, buildings, and materials) to reduce grind
…and much more! (yes, the whole list of all improvements is quite long)
💚 New Content & Features
Completion of all major quests, tournaments, and heart events
Romance + Marriage system
A brand-new Blob World featuring an extensive quest
Blob fusion
…and much more!
Once again, thank you for being part of the Ova Magica journey 💚
— Claudia and Top Hat Studios

This update features new content and also lots of improvements based on your feedback.
The team uses this occasion to thank all players who left us kind words, suggestions and ideas 🙏. Your support during Early Access helps a lot!

We are looking forward to the full release and improving the game further during the remaining Early Access period. If you have more feedback and ideas do not hesitate to reach out via the Steam Forum or our Discord.
Please also leave a Steam review if you enjoy playing Ova Magica - it helps a lot to get some visibility💚 !
Below are SPOILERS, so stop reading here if you prefer to play the new content blind and figure out how to unlock the new features for yourself.
Venture with Lapis into the blob world and discover the secret of the legendary blob fossil egg! The blob world comes as always with new blobs to collect.
Fill the level 4 heart fully for Lapis and Lazuli to unlock their new friendship event. The event is a special “duo event”. Follow the quests of the event to gain access to the Prehistoric Badlands.
If you are still missing some seasonal or festival items you can now skip quickly to the required season:
Re-visit the Keeper of Time. The blob gifts you a legendary egg and offers you to progress time to the next season.

How to unlock: Available the day after completing Jade's level 4 heart event (in which you meet the Keeper of Time first time). Interact with your bed or tent and you will see an additional choice "Dream until next day".
All 13 befriendable Npcs are now playable until level 5.
How to unlock: Progress the friendship of all Npcs to level 5.
An x-ray device which can store blob eggs and show you their content before hatching them.
How to unlock: complete the Prehistoric Badlands blob world.
Based on feedback that some players experienced motion sickness when playing Ova Magica.
There are now 2 new settings in the pause menu which hopefully will prevent or reduce it:
Disable Camera Smoothing: Removes all camera “after smoothing /motion” which can greatly help when the motion sickness occurs mainly when moving the player character and rotating the camera.
Battle Camera Setting: You can choose between the options “Dynamic (Default)”, “Less Rotation” and “Static” to help reduce motion sickness during battles.
Based on players' feedback that switching blobs for farming, battling and other tasks was tedious.
Flint now sells the “Team Terminal” blueprint. Use it to register blob teams and swap between them quickly without having to go into blob barns and navigate the UI each time.
Based on players' feedback to see more information what the skills and abilities of blobs do.
Descriptions for blob skills and abilities can now be displayed in several “UI locations” with the "Skill Info" button.

You can now select the new choice “View museum inventory” when interacting with the donation box. The museum inventory lists already donated items and shows how many items are still missing in the botanic garden, dining hall and aquarium area of the museum.
Based on feedback that players want instantly transfer items from the inventory to the magical storage without having to navigate through all the individual items.
With the new “Quick Transfer” button you can now move all items from your inventory to the magical storage which are already stored in the magical storage too.
Note: the quick transfer does not occupy new free slots in the magical storage, if the max allowed amount of 999 for an item slot is reached
Based on players' feedback that it's tedious to walk back to your tent/house to save the game.
All fast travel points can now also be used to save the game (except in the Clover Town area during festivals).
The display of the old “Grade” (A-F) on blob skills was removed. Instead the status effects and stat value changes (attack, defense, speed) are now displayed for more infos.

The “Skill Grade” was an early concept that was not yet properly implemented. During several tests in Early Access, it ended up not working well with the battle balancing. A more “complex” system isn't always good and can cause confusion, so we decided to remove it and not force something into the game that doesn't really work well.

With progressing Early-Access development, we had to rework some of the code to make it future-proof. As a result, the old button remappings no longer work after this update. If you have previously changed the default controls, you will sadly have to redo them once. We apologize to all players affected by this.
(The save data or any other settings are not affected. Only the key/button remapping in the pause menu settings.)
First we want to share the updated roadmap with you! The current update is the 0.8 version.
⚠️Attention: Below the roadmap pic are descriptions with SPOILERS of the new content! Stop reading after the roadmap if you do not want to be spoilered.

The 7th blob world which was initially not planned but added as Kickstarter stretchgoal was for now sadly removed from the roadmap to not delay the 1.0 release further. One of the main reasons is that we just need more time to polish the 6 main blob worlds and add still missing features to them.

We plan adding the 7th blob world in an update after full release also based on your ideas and feedback for possible new blobs + quests. We want to apologize for the change and hope for your understanding.
In the new blob world you can find several new blobs like the Tiger, Red Panda, Peacock and more. It also comes with new resources, like the Mithril ore vein, and the greenhouse blueprint.
In the greenhouse you can grow different crops all year round. Comes with a sprinkler and a thermostat to set the season.

Inside are signs of volcanic activity. This could also explain the hot spring that Garnet discovered and that powers the Spa. In the cave you can find new blobs, coal resources and the very rare Emberpetal which can revive a fainted blob in battle.
Level 4: Flint, Lapis, Emerald
Level 5: Garnet, Opal, Jasper, Carnelian, Citrine, Emerald, Ruby, Charoi
Progress Flint's friendship to unlock the new building "Blob Paradise".
You can leave a blob in the Blob Paradise to train it. The maximum possible level is determined by your tournament rank.
The Blob Paradise you can also purchase blueprints for devices which can train your blob stats. These are the blob wheel (Speed), trampoline (Defense) and training target (Attack).
NEW ITEMS: HEALTH + ENERGY BOOSTER
Boosters permanently increase a blob's health or energy which helps to level up your blobs. This items are rare and can be found mainly in blob world chests.
Test your blob trainer skills in the Mithril Cup tournament! (unlocked with all NPCs friendship being level 4)
Improved Farming Tool Controls
Can now hold the key/button for most farming actions instead having to press the key again.
Affected actions: watering crops, planting seeds, hoeing ground, harvesting crops
Dropped items+crops do not disappear when leaving area

Crops and other items(for example dropped in the shooting start event or by wild blobs) do now not disappear when leaving an area. You can go inside your blob barn and return to the farm without worrying about the items being gone like before.
Not collected items are still removed on the next day.
UI for Blob Placing can now also access blobs from the barn

Mainly the auto-petter and new blob training devices are affected. When in a blob barn you can now access blobs of your barn and team. This avoids having to put a blob in your team when you want to place it on an Auto-Petter or training device in the barn.
